input.summary: Carve a Customer 60-day non-renewal notice into the auto-renewal trigger
input.comment: [Playbook] We carved a Customer non-renewal election into the auto-renewal trigger itself, so renewal is stopped by sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal, consistent with our fallback position of a non-renewal window of no more than 60 days. Kubient's 90-day post-Initial-Term notice right is untouched.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless Customer gives sixty (60) days' notice of non-renewal or earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
